subject: Brief intro — pick a 30m timeband and confirm who should join
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Lin <tom.lin@cleargrid.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-08-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Brief intro — pick a 30m timeband and confirm who should join

Hi Tom — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a narrow set of next steps so we can lock a short 30‑minute intro/demo:

Recap (one line): ClearGrid is evaluating inference platforms for batch + low‑latency routing across multi‑region GPUs; priority is predictable per‑token cost and KV cache behavior for peak windows.

What I propose next (actionable): pick one of the three 30‑minute timebands below and confirm who from ClearGrid should join (eng, security, product or procurement). I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda and include a 1‑page prep doc.

Proposed 30m timebands (all PT):
- Option A: Tue Aug 29, 9:00–9:30 AM — best for eng + product (fast technical overview + high‑level ROI)
- Option B: Wed Aug 30, 11:00–11:30 AM — good for security + infra questions (we can include security lead)
- Option C: Thu Aug 31, 2:00–2:30 PM — catch‑all that works for cross‑functional groups / procurement on call

Meeting goal: 30m product intro + targeted Q&A. If you want a deeper tech dive instead, we can book a 45m follow‑up focusing on model quantization and routing.

Prep items (I’ll attach): discovery notes and a 1‑page agenda. Please tell me: 1) which option, 2) who will join (names & roles), 3) any must‑cover items (e.g., data residency, SOC 2, burst capacity).

Thanks — I’ll hold the three windows until I hear back.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0147
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery_notes.pdf (summary of call), redwood-demo-agenda.md (1p)
From: Tom Lin <tom.lin@cleargrid.io>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-08-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Brief intro — pick a 30m timeband and confirm who should join

Chloe — appreciate the clear recap. Option B (Wed Aug 30, 11:00 AM PT) works best for our team. Attendees so far:
- Tom Lin (CTO) — I’ll drive the call
- Aisha O’Connor (Lead SRE) — will cover infra questions
- Miguel Santos (Product) — high‑level product fit

Two quick asks:
1) Can you include a brief note on where Redwood keeps logs/audit trails (we may bring our security person on short notice)?
2) If you have a one‑pager on pricing levers (batching, cache, quant), can that be attached to the invite?

If we need to shift to Option C for calendar reasons I’ll let you know by EOD Monday. Otherwise B is preferred. Looking forward to the overview.

—
Tom
Tom Lin | CTO, ClearGrid
tom.lin@cleargrid.io

Great — locking Wed Aug 30, 11:00–11:30 AM PT for Option B.

I’ll attach: the discovery notes, a short agenda, and a one‑page pricing levers summary that calls out batching, KV cache impact, and quantization tradeoffs. On audit/logs: we keep audit and request logs in the customer control plane for Dedicated/Private; hosted customers can enable a 90‑day audit export—Kar says he’ll bring a short security slide to cover exact retention and KMS options.

Actioning internally: tagging karthik (AE) and marissa (Solutions Engineer) to join and prep a 5‑minute security/ops section. If either of you need any specifics to prep, reply in‑thread.

I’ll send a calendar invite in the next 20 minutes (with Zoom link) and include the attachments. If Tom later prefers a 45m technical deep‑dive instead of a 30m, we can expand on quantization and routing.

Thanks —
Chloe
